messages:
Lina: quick cross-team ping — while doing a docs sweep i found a handful of pages that still show the legacy function_call pattern and several examples with inconsistent structured-output shapes. can we triage into a small safe plan? :wave:

Marco: i can run a targeted linkcheck and grep for the old pattern. suggestion: split into PR1 for redirects/link fixes and PR2 for snippet migrations + a short migration note. keeps CI simple.

Tess: sounds good. i'll take the snippet work (py + ts) and the guardrails blurb. can you drop the grep results in the issue?

Lina: added grep + short list to the issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1188 — hotspots: /docs/guides/tool-calling/, /docs/reference/structured-output/, and /docs/examples/python/. also two external posts pointing to old slugs.

Marco: running linkcheck now. quick CI snippet:
```
LinkChecker: 404 on /examples/old-tool.md (ref in /docs/guides/tool-calling/index.md)
LinkChecker: 404 on /examples/old-envelope.md
```
I'll open PR1 to add redirects + move originals to /docs/legacy-examples/.

Tess: for snippet migration, propose the minimal before/after examples we use in docs: 
```py
# before
resp = client.chat.completions.create(..., function_call={"name": "get_details"})
# after
resp = client.chat.completions.create(..., tools=[get_details])
```
And a compact-envelope canonical example we can link to. i'll prepare the python and TS variants.

Lina: also please add a 2-line migration note in /docs/migration.md that points to the compact-envelope page and the SDK snippet updates. keep it tiny.

Marco: opened PR1: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5220 — redirects + legacy moves. LinkBot reports 8 broken links initially; PR fixes the ones in the grep. tagging @Tess for follow-up.

BuildBot: automated: linkcheck found 8 broken links in run. report: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/reports/5220

Tess: working on PR2 branch docs/migrate/toolcall-1188. i'll add: 1) py + ts before/after snippets, 2) compact-envelope canonical example, 3) guardrails bullets (explicit property types, avoid union-of-arrays at top-level, require critical fields), and 4) one-line compatibility shim for older SDKs.

Marco: PR1 merged. redirects live. nice and small. :tada:

Tess: draft compact-envelope sample (to be formatted in docs page):
```json
{
  "envelope": {
    "tool_call": {"name": "summarize", "args": {"text": "..."}},
    "output_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"summary": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["summary"]}
  }
}
```
I'll also add a tiny parser-fallback note: schema parser first, then compact-envelope, then heuristics.

Lina: agree on parser fallback ordering in the text. also include a short sentence recommending explicit schemas for tool args to avoid ambiguous parses.

Tess: opened PR2: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5229 — contains snippets, compact-envelope page, guardrails, and a 2-line migration note. requesting reviews from @Lina and @Marco.

BuildBot: automated: docs preview built: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/preview/5229 — preview success.

Marco: reviewed PR2, left a tiny wording nit about the compatibility shim wording. suggest we call it "temporary shim" and recommend SDK upgrade in the migration note.

Tess: addressed nit, updated migration note to recommend upgrade and kept the shim as a fallback. pushed changes.

LinkRat: automated: post-merge linkcheck run passed. no remaining broken links in affected areas.

Lina: merged PR2. thank you all! follow-ups: 1) i'll open a short sweep issue for python snippets across the site (low priority), 2) add a README to /docs/legacy-examples/ explaining why files were moved, and 3) if anyone finds external references to old slugs please drop URLs here and i'll add permanent redirects. :sparkles:
